text_normalization_rule: Unicode NFC; remove control characters; collapse horizontal whitespace; preserve inferred paragraph boundaries; do not guess at PDF line-end dehyphenation. Character counts collapse all remaining whitespace to one space.
page_count_rule: Count PDF pages containing the paper body or substantive appendices. Exclude reference-only pages, acknowledgements/reference pages, blank pages, covers, and tables of contents. A mixed acknowledgements/references page is excluded conservatively.
redistribution_policy: PDF files remain local and are ignored by Git. Recreate the corpus from the versioned arXiv PDF URLs below, then verify SHA-256. This conservative policy avoids redistributing papers that use the arXiv non-exclusive distribution license.
